image_description: A close-up macro shot of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet, perched on a yellow flower. The butterfly's wings are held vertically closed, displaying the ventral side which is dark brown with distinct small eyespots (ocelli). The body appears fuzzy and brown, blending with the wing coloration. The background consists of blurred yellow flowers and green foliage.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wings are dark brown, and at least two clear ocelli are visible on the visible wing surface, matching the diagnostic pattern of a ringlet.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wings held closed at rest revealing cryptic ventral patterning.

The body appears slender and distinctly hairy/fuzzy, consistent with the species description.

alignment_reasoning: The image demonstrates excellent class conformance. All testable checkpoints regarding wing pattern (ocelli), color, posture, and general anatomy are met. The only untestable checkpoint (forelegs) is due to occlusion, not absence. The subject is unmistakably a ringlet butterfly.
artifact_reasoning: The image is high quality but shows subtle signs of AI generation. There is minor texture bleeding at the wing edges and a lack of crisp mechanical detail in the legs where they touch the flower, resulting in a slight deduction from perfection.
